Hi Tom — thanks for the note and the context. Happy to help. Below is a concise baseline for our hosted API (standard public tiers). I’ve attached the quarter’s standard ratecard and included a one-paragraph model roster. If you want a tailored pilot proposal I can loop in Ben and Marissa to propose a short-term discount structure.

Baseline hosted (per 1M tokens) — standard public rates: 
- Input tokens: $1.25 per 1M tokens
- Output tokens: $8.50 per 1M tokens
- Embeddings (small vectors): $6.00 per 1M embedding units

Notes:
- Output is typically billed at a higher rate due to generation compute.
- Rates above are for our verified medium-family models (balanced latency/quality). Large-family models are ~1.8x output cost; small-family models are ~0.6x output cost.

Supported model families (hosted catalog snapshot):
- small-family: optimized-compact-1 (low latency, lower quality)
- medium-family: balanced-ensemble-2 (recommended for 512-token completions)
- large-family: high-capacity-3 (best quality, higher cost)

Model catalog (live): https://redwood.ai/models/catalog
Standard ratecard attached: Redwood_Q3_Standard_Ratecard.pdf

Pilot logistics suggestion: 30-minute sync to review traffic profile, expected latency SLOs, and whether an embeddings allowance should be included. If you confirm interest I’ll get Ben to draft a short pilot proposal.

Best,
